description: This file defines the 'Cod' controller class for the OpenCart platform, handling the cash-on-delivery payment method, including displaying the payment option and confirming the order.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: Controller class for handling Cash on Delivery payment method in OpenCart, including methods to display the payment view and confirm the order.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language and view data to display the COD payment method during checkout.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes the order confirmation, updates order history, and redirects to relevant pages based on payment and order status.
